text:
kevin: FYI we hit a regression in the embeddings canary on eu-west, need someone with prod deploy rights to roll a pinned model back for a quick test. /cc @lina @aj

lina: what exactly failed? logs? can we hotfix without a full rollback?

kevin: latency spikes + 5% drop in recall on the eval set after last onboard. sample logs: ```2026-03-18T10:12:03Z model-server[pid]: cache-miss 99% seq=512 latency=420ms```

aj: if ops needs to deploy, we need JIT elevation + MFA and a clear justification note. how long estimate?

kevin: ~15m to pin to v2.1.3-quantized and validate canary. request: temporary deployer role for maria or samir.

maria: I can do it but don't have the deployer role in prod. pinged infra for JIT earlier, no answer yet.

samir: security: we can approve a scoped elevation for 30m if we get a deploy plan, rollback criteria, and an audit comment. Must be MFAed and use a short-lived session token.

aj: deploy plan (2 steps): 1) pin model endpoint to v2.1.3 on canary nodes 2) run smoke evals and redirect 10% traffic for 5m 3) revert if recall < baseline -3% or latency > 300ms. rollback criteria ok?

lina: add an explicit note: no schema or config changes, only model binary swap. Also add release notes blurb for ops log.

kevin: added plan and rollback thresholds to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-8721 — requesting maria for 30m elevation.

deploy-bot: deploy-elevation-request received for user=maria scope=deployer-prod duration=30m ticket=INF-8721 state=pending_approval

samir: approved pending MFA. Please do not escalate beyond 30m. Keep logs open and attach token id to ticket.

maria: starting elevation flow. MFA prompt incoming.

oncall-bot: MFA verified for user=maria session_id=SESS-9f3b elevation_expiry=2026-03-18T11:05:00Z

maria: running pin now: ```rdwctl model pin --endpoint=embeddings-eu --model=v2.1.3-quantized --notes "canary rollback due to eval regression"```

kevin: thanks, running smoke evals now. attaching run id: run_8231

lina: results?

kevin: smoke evals: recall delta = -0.8% (ok), p50 latency = 210ms (ok). Redirecting 10% traffic for 5m.

aj: keep monitoring. If anything crosses thresholds, initiate immediate rollback and notify #incidents.

maria: 5m window complete, metrics stable. Releasing elevation in 2m.

deploy-bot: elevation for user=maria revoked session_id=SESS-9f3b

kevin: confirmed stable for 30m post-change. closing ticket with notes and attach audit: token=SESS-9f3b, action=pin, duration=30m

samir: security note logged. We'll run a follow-up review for whether this should be added to scheduled change window controls to avoid repeated JIT in peak hours.

aj: thanks everyone. I'll add a short release-note entry and follow-up item for the next release checklist to pre-pin canaries when onboardings are scheduled. :white_check_mark:
